124:t_108:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「I can't stay as detached as you!」

124:t_108:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Control your own heart. That's the kind of battle we'll be fighting from now on.」

124:t_108:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't die, $$カレン$$. If you disappear too, $$ルルーシュ$$ will be unbearably sad.」

124:t_108:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「...I understand. I'll remember your words!」

124:t_109:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
($$キリコ$$ is sensing something too...)

124:t_109:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(The $$新地球皇国$$... $$サイデリアル$$... Their existence makes my skin crawl for reasons beyond their being invaders...)

124:t_109:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(Where on earth is this war headed...?)

124:t_110:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「My target is $$サイデリアル$$...」

124:t_110:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「I won't hesitate anymore...! Those who start wars are the enemies I must defeat... In other words, they are evil!」

124:t_111:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't overdo it, $$ヒルデ$$! You'd better not go down in a blaze of glory here!」

124:t_111:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I know...! Our fight will go on until we liberate Earth!」

124:t_111:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「As long as you understand that, it's all good! Don't die, $$ヒルデ$$!」

124:t_111:3.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「You don't die either, $$デュオ$$!」

124:t_112:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... If their influence spreads any further, the consequences will be irreversible...!」

124:t_112:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We must strike at their heart as soon as possible... To do that, we need to gather our forces.」

124:t_113:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So my comrades have gathered here too.」

124:t_113:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「The strength to resist the Empire isn't dead yet.」

124:t_113:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Let's fight too... to restore peace to this Earth once again!」

124:t_114:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come at me, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll pay you back here for what happened in $$新日本$$!」

124:t_114:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't think you've won until you've stopped my breathing! I'll fight you even if I'm the last man left!」

124:t_115:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you understand the difference in our strength, hurry up and wave the white flag. You don't want to die, do you?」

124:t_115:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know. However noble your words, you always live with despair.」

124:t_115:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「No, I won't shut up. As far as I'm concerned, your life is better because you can still have hope.」

124:t_115:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This overwhelming emotion... It's hatred that blankets everything...」

124:t_115:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you won't obey us, I'll simply free the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ at once...!」

124:t_115:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But first, I'll paint over the hope and despair inside you with nothing but despair!」
